scope: Explicit native collection-aware query results and buffered CLI list presentation; normal scalar/source branches retain existing semantics.

boundaries: Bare lists use the explicit collection-aware query service under --multivalues or --collections, including explicitly decoded attachments.
Lists retain order, duplicate and NULL members; [] differs from [NULL]. Individual members use existing typed CLI spellings, not JSON or native Access display metadata.
Same-parent hidden .Value criteria retain complete projected lists; existing .Value child expansion and scalar-only query behavior remain.
New tests cover wildcard/alias/static-derived TOP/scalar ordering, scalar aliases after interleaved lists, NULL members/duplicates/empty lists and buffered output-limit failures.
The old wildcard-refusal case was replaced by a positive exact-output assertion; unsupported Count(list), DISTINCT(list), mixed list/child projection and ordinary opt-in refusals remain.
No unrun original-file replay, performance, Windows/ACE behavior or complete read/query compatibility claim.
